headline: Day 4: J&K are 61/6 in bad light chasing 326 against MP, Services need 137 with four wickets left against Maharashtra, Delhi lead Bengal by 72 with one wicket left, and Jharkhand–Kerala ended in a draw.
UP and Baroda have banked innings wins; champions J&K are 61/6 chasing 326 against MP with bad light the main threat to MP, and Puducherry were 18/2 chasing 291 in Nagpur.
Karnataka declared at 337/9 and have Andhra 55/4 chasing 194, Assam are still behind Punjab, and Saurashtra are batting out the game against Chhattisgarh.
Gujarat beat Odisha by 10 wickets and Jharkhand drew with first-innings points; Services need 137 with four wickets left against Maharashtra, and Delhi lead Bengal by 72 with one wicket left.
Haryana joined Mumbai as winners; Tamil Nadu were 73/0 chasing 282 in Jaipur, and Railways were batting out a draw against Uttarakhand.
Manipur were 185/7, 43 short of 228 against Mizoram, Sikkim lead Meghalaya by 141 with three wickets left, and Nagaland were awarded their opener by forfeit.
